item.title: Man 'would rather live in prison' than 'deal with' his 83-year-old wife, so he shot her dead: Police
item.description: An 80-year-old Florida man shot his 83-year-old wife who suffered from dementia during an argument about going on a cruise, later telling cops he'd rather sit in a jail cell than deal with her, authorities say. The post Man 'would rather live in prison' than 'deal with' his 83-year-old wife, so he shot her dead: Police first appeared on Law & Crime.

item.description: Bodycam video shared by the department captured the moments the boys were found, one of them naked, the other covered in feces. No adults were in the home. item.title: 'We are going to kill him': Man guaranteed he would assassinate Trump and former president in 'sniper attack,' DOJ says
item.description: A South Carolina man is facing his third indictment for threatening a president, this time taking aim at Donald Trump in a letter from prison that said "we will kill him too," according to the DOJ.
